redmodCli.requiredInvocationRule: Biology tooling must pass the Cyberpunk game root explicitly and validate REDmod output; exit code 0 alone is insufficient because attended probing proved root-ignore/no-mod false positives are possible.

launcherActivation.requirement: REDlauncher Enable mods ON activates Biology; Enable mods OFF yields native/vanilla-play behavior without uninstalling Biology.
launcherActivation.missingOrFalseBehavior: fail closed to Biology inactive regardless of persisted Biology presentation preference or loaded supplemental REDscript
launcherActivation.sessionBoundary: restart/relaunch through the supported launcher flow; no polling watcher is installed

playerFlow.prerequisite: Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 plus official REDmod support installed for the player's platform/store
playerFlow.firstInstall: close game; copy the game-root-shaped Biology release into Cyberpunk 2077 so mods/Biology and the exact shared redscript/cybercmd runtime plumbing land intact; use the supported REDmod enable/deploy flow with Enable mods ON; launch normally through Steam
playerFlow.developerDeterministicDeploy: use tools/Deploy-BiologyRedmod.ps1 from the active Biology checkout after package installation; do not reconstruct raw redMod.exe quoting from historical chat/docs
playerFlow.update: close game; use biology/build-manifest.json as the prior exact Biology ownership receipt; never overwrite/delete changed ambiguous files automatically; install the newer exact package; refresh REDmod when REDmod payload changed
playerFlow.disable: turn REDlauncher Enable mods OFF, then relaunch; the REDmod-owned activation marker is absent and all Biology behavior gates yield to native Cyberpunk behavior without uninstall or save/preference reset
playerFlow.reenable: turn REDlauncher Enable mods ON, then relaunch; the REDmod activation marker becomes available and Biology resumes while the save-backed E3 presentation preference remains independent and presentation-only
playerFlow.uninstall: close game; double-click Uninstall Biology.exe from the Cyberpunk 2077 game root; no PowerShell, Git, Vortex, mod manager, or game reinstall is required

supplementalRuntime.startupCompileContract: redscript supplies engine/tools/scc.exe plus r6/config/cybercmd/scc.toml; standalone cybercmd executes the configured InvokeScc startup task so current r6/scripts sources regenerate r6/cache/modded/final.redscripts without restoring RED4ext/CET.
supplementalRuntime.launcherOffAudit: Loose Biology REDscript plus redscript/cybercmd infrastructure are outside mods/Biology and may still load while REDlauncher mods are OFF. They are therefore not activation authority; CRRealpassSettings requires the REDmod-owned activation marker before Biology behavior or E3 presentation can activate.
supplementalRuntime.ownershipRule: First-party Biology files outside mods/Biology are exact-hash Biology-owned per file. The retained generic redscript/cybercmd payload is exact-hash inventoried but shared/preserved by the player uninstaller.
supplementalRuntime.settingsArchitecture: The E3 preference is Biology-owned save state and the existing Biology body shell edits it directly. No external settings provider, ArchiveXL resource layer, RED4ext plugin, or pause-menu provider registration is packaged.

ownerManifest.rule: Every installed payload file is listed exactly once. Biology-owned files may be automatically deleted only when the path is in Biology's narrow allowlist and the current SHA-256 matches. Generic/shared redscript and cybercmd files are never automatically removed by the player uninstaller.

playerUninstaller.toolchain: single WinForms executable compiled from repository C# using the Windows .NET Framework compiler; no script/runtime sidecar is packaged
playerUninstaller.preferences: stored in saves and therefore untouched because saves are never targeted
playerUninstaller.genericDependencies: preserve retained redscript and cybercmd files
playerUninstaller.redmodRefresh: run official redMod.exe deploy with explicit game root; never recursively clear r6/cache/modded

conditionalSupplementalRoots.condition: Exact first-party Biology REDscript files only; directory may be removed only when empty.
Exact pinned generic redscript files are inventoried but preserved by player uninstall.
Exact pinned generic redscript config is inventoried but preserved by player uninstall.
Exact pinned generic redscript task config is inventoried but preserved by player uninstall.
Exact pinned cybercmd.asi task runner is inventoried but preserved by player uninstall; root is never recursively Biology-owned.

Exact pinned standalone cybercmd ASI-loader files global.ini/version.dll are inventoried but preserved by player uninstall; existing/changed shared loader files must fail closed to preservation rather than broad deletion.
Retained redscript and cybercmd license notices are inventoried and preserved with the shared components.

cleanRoom.reason: The W13 cybercmd startup-runner addition is a structural runtime dependency correction after direct installed evidence proved current redscript sources were not regenerating the configured final.redscripts. Parent integration owns attended launcher/runtime validation against a release-shaped artifact; routine Biology removal still must not require a Steam reinstall.

acceptedDirectGameGates: real five-stage REDmod deployment using corrected explicit-root helper
remainingDirectGameGates: standalone cybercmd executes redscript scc.toml and regenerates the configured r6/cache/modded/final.redscripts for the exact installed candidate
REDmod activation marker exact-compiles/deploys in the combined candidate
REDlauncher Enable mods ON activates Biology
REDlauncher Enable mods OFF yields Biology-inactive native behavior while shared redscript/cybercmd infrastructure remains non-authoritative
E3 preference can be edited in the Biology body shell and persists across save/reload
OFF-to-ON relaunch restores Biology while preserving E3 preference/state
Uninstall Biology.exe removes exact Biology-owned payload and official REDmod refresh leaves no stale Biology activation
changed-file refusal and another-REDmod preservation on a real supported install
rules: The repository root is not a player package.
mods/Biology is the authoritative first-party REDmod namespace and launcher activation signal owner.
No saved Biology presentation preference may override an absent launcher activation signal.
Shared framework/game roots are never deleted wholesale.
The retained generic runtime is limited to redscript plus standalone cybercmd, with exact current consumers recorded in manifest/dependency-graph.json.
cybercmd is startup compilation plumbing only and must never become Biology activation or gameplay authority.
The playable builder may read the installed supported game for version/exact compilation but may not deploy or modify it.
If ownership/hash/path safety cannot be proven, automatic deletion fails closed.
No successful CI/build result is live-game acceptance.
